title: How Far Can LLMs Go in Generating Android Lint Checks from Natural Language?
abstract: arXiv:2611.28159v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static analysis tools such as Android Lint, PMD, and CodeQL let developers add custom checks for project-specific rules. However, authoring a check is a demanding programming task: a rule can be stated in a few sentences, yet turning it into a working, tested check requires detailed knowledge of the analysis framework and its issue-detection logic. Recent work generates such checks with large language models (LLMs), but each system needs more than the natural language description a developer always has: a bug-fix patch, a CVE record, or a developer-written test suite to repair against. No prior work measures whether an LLM can turn a description into a working check, or what external knowledge it needs to do so. We introduce LintBench, a human-validated benchmark of 113 real-world Android Lint checks, each paired with a natural language description and its original test suite as a held-out oracle. translated_title: 大语言模型能从自然语言生成Android Lint检查到多远的程度？
translated_abstract: 静态分析工具（如Android Lint、PMD和CodeQL）允许开发人员为项目特定的规则添加自定义检查。然而，编写一个检查是一项要求很高的编程任务：一条规则可以用几句话来表述，但要将其转化为一个可运行且经过测试的检查，需要对分析框架及其问题检测逻辑有深入的了解。最近的研究使用大语言模型（LLM）来生成此类检查，但每个系统都需要开发人员所拥有的自然语言描述之外的额外信息：例如一个错误修复补丁、一条CVE记录，或一个开发人员编写的用于对照修复的测试套件。此前尚无研究衡量LLM能否仅凭描述就生成可运行的检查，或者它需要哪些外部知识才能做到这一点。我们提出了LintBench，这是一个经过人工验证的基准，包含113个真实世界的Android Lint检查，每个检查都配有自然语言描述及其原始测试套件作为保留的验证标准。我们评估了四个LLM，包括propr（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了LintBench基准（包含113个经人工验证的真实Android Lint检查及自然语言描述），首次系统评估了LLM能否仅凭自然语言描述生成可运行的Lint检查及其所需的外部知识。
